question: Will Weil Gotshal announce a wind-down this week (by Nov 2, 2026)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Weil, Gotshal & Manges publicly announces a decision to wind down or dissolve the firm — confirmed by an official firm statement or widely reported by credible news outlets as a concluded decision (not merely under discussion) — strictly after 2026-10-26T04:00:00Z and at or before 2026-11-02T05:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if no such announcement of a decided wind-down or dissolution is confirmed within the window.

Clarifications:
- Reports that a wind-down is being discussed, explored, or considered as one of multiple options do not satisfy the "Yes" condition; only a firm-level announcement or confirmed decision to wind down qualifies.
